test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Highest.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate option to fill in the blanks is Highest.
 
• The word Highest means is with **a large vertical extent. **
 
• Thus the correct option is **Highest.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Smallest-** It means **smaller than average or customary in size. **
 
• **Latest- **It means** on the most recent date.**
 
• **Largest- **It means **size, extent, or capability that is significant or comparatively large.**
